title: The Nine instruct building a copper Faraday cage for clearer transmission

tellings.quote: you know okay, look, you're contacting us through a psychic, but if you want a clearer feed, a a clearer transmission, you have to put the psychic in a Faraday cage.

plain: In the 1950s, beings calling themselves the Nine, who were said to speak through a psychic at the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine, told the group to put the psychic inside a copper Faraday cage, a metal box that blocks outside electrical signals, to get a clearer message, according to a researcher named Greg Malatzi. Malatzi bases this on the Round Table tape recordings, the group's recorded sessions, and paraphrases the message to Michels: "you're contacting us through a psychic, but if you want a clearer feed, a clearer transmission, you have to put the psychic in a Faraday cage." If true, it would mean the supposed contact was giving practical, physical instructions for building equipment.
